name: Mystic Warriors Vita
author: Tobic-99
description: A static recompilation of Mystic Warriors (Konami, 1993, GX128 arcade board) to native ARM code. The game's 68000 program is translated to C++ and linked with a native runtime that replaces the board: memory map, EEPROM, a software renderer (tile layers, sprites, shadows, blending) and the sound board (Z80 interpreter, two K054539).
